name: Gutshof zum Schluxen
beschreibung: The Gutshof zum Schluxen is a holiday apartment in Tirol. The accommodation is located in a rural region of the Alpen. Guests have their own living area with kitchen and bathroom. Hiking and cycling trails start directly near the property. In winter, several ski areas can be reached by car. The surroundings are ideal for excursions into nature. The building is kept in the traditional style of the region.
